name: player_apply_camera_state
description: Player::ApplyCameraState applies first-person and third-person camera transitions, preserving steering mode, camera state history, camera target distance, and zOpt camera-mode synchronization.
known_limits: The smoke covers first-person/third-person transitions, clear-screen restore, projectile attach/restore side effects, FX visibility, variant-tag clearing, and zOpt camera bit synchronization. tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player camera/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x405c90 validates same-state and clear-screen/projectile early-outs, first-person steering-mode save/clear, third-person steering restore and camera distance reset, projectile attach/restore side effects, and final zOpt camera-mode synchronization.
The native smoke checks first-person and third-person transitions through zOpt::SetCameraMode, including option bits, steering bit behavior, previous state, and camera-distance/elevation fields.
